description:
Sol Yoon comes from a family of renowned artists for generations. Unbeknownst to him, his gaze follows his servant Makgae. Makgae's talent shines as he grows older, and Sol's father, Lord Yoon, notices it. Sol feels jealous of Makgae for earning his father's trust, the same father who never taught his own son.

**Original Webcomic:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=3466037), eComix, [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1746006189), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/drizzle), [Lezhin (Obsolete)](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/yeonwoo)

[Official English Translation](https://netcomics.com/comic/yeonwoo)
